dataset.name: Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success
dataset.fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of the normalized feature table plus source target, preserving UCI row and column order.

design.primary_target: Dropout by the dataset observation endpoint versus no recorded dropout by that endpoint (Enrolled or Graduate).
design.target_boundary: Enrolled is not treated as academic success; it is only grouped with Graduate for the primary no-recorded-dropout endpoint and is removed in a dedicated sensitivity analysis.
design.audit_only_rationale: Gender, nationality, international status, and special-needs status are held out of prediction and retained for subgroup evaluation. Exclusion of direct attributes does not prove the remaining feature set is proxy-free.
design.model: L2 logistic regression with train-only scaling and one-hot encoding

overall.threshold_note: 0.50 is a descriptive reference threshold, not an optimized or ethically preferred intervention threshold.

gender.interpretation: Descriptive group audit only. Gaps are computed only across groups meeting min_group_size=30; they are not fairness verdicts.

repeated_split_robustness.interpretation: Repeated stratified 80/20 splits quantify split/training sensitivity. They are robustness evidence, not an external-validation substitute.

training_refit_bootstrap.method: Stratified bootstrap of the original training partition with model and preprocessing refit in every resample; evaluated on the fixed untouched holdout.

target_sensitivity.definition: Dropout versus Graduate only; Enrolled cases excluded as unresolved endpoint sensitivity.

risk_register.mitigation: Treat outputs as descriptive research evidence; require institutional review and external validation before any use.

risk_register.mitigation: Do not deploy from this study; prospectively test intervention harms and benefits with human oversight.

risk_register.description: The binary primary target combines Enrolled and Graduate as no recorded dropout at the dataset endpoint.
risk_register.mitigation: Report the endpoint definition and a Dropout-versus-Graduate sensitivity analysis.

risk_register.description: Subgroup estimates can be unstable for sparse protected/intersectional groups.
risk_register.mitigation: Apply minimum evidence thresholds, retain warnings, and avoid gap estimates for under-sized groups.

risk_register.description: Single-institution historical data may not transport to other institutions or present-day cohorts.
risk_register.mitigation: Require external and temporal validation before operational consideration.
